title: Lightweight Cipher Linear Diffusion XOR Circuits (Pyjamask M0..M3/Inv/M_K, PHOTON-256 MDS, Clyde-128 L-box, Ascon)
description: Thirteen pure Lean 4.36.0 (zero Mathlib) certified straight-line XOR gate minimization tracks covering Pyjamask-128's nine 32×32 dense circulants (forward M0..M3, key M_K, and kernel-proved inverses InvM0..InvM3), PHOTON-256's 32×32 GF(2^4) MDS matrix, Clyde-128/Spook's 64×64 L-box, and Ascon's 64×64 NIST SP 800-232 diffusion layers Σ0 and Σ2, pinned verbatim to `rweather/lightweight-crypto@fa4ec9a021` (MIT).

tasks.title: Pyjamask-128 M0 (0xa3861085) (32×32): minimize straight-line XOR gate count (baseline 320)
tasks.description: Submit a straight-line XOR circuit implementing Pyjamask-128 M0 (0xa3861085) (32×32 over GF(2)) in `LwcLinearXor/PyjamaskM0Circuit.lean` (`LwcLinearXor.pyjamaskM0Score`, `LwcLinearXor.pyjamaskM0Gates`, `LwcLinearXor.pyjamaskM0Outputs`). Seeded at 320 XORs (frontier: ~100-130). Frozen Lean 4.36.0 kernel proofs verify well-formedness, XOR count, and exact equivalence on all 2^32 inputs via linearity soundness.
